newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania cen.bank forex reserve at $1.0 bln in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Romania cen.bank forex reserve at $1.0 bln in Oct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said its total foreign exchange reserves rose to $1.0 billion in October from $703.6 million in September as it almost ended a 1996 borrowing programme from the international markets.
Over the past two months the BNR raised about $270 million in five-year Samurais and $175 million from a syndicated loan arranged through ABN Amro AAH.AS and Citibank.
The central bank was entitled to draw up to $1.5 billion from the private capital markets this year. It raised $1.4 billion so far.
Romania's foreign reserve assets of the banking system were $2.72 billion in September, down from $2.78 billion in August. Data on October's overall reserve assets were not available.

The end-September reserve assets figure includes gold reserves of about 87 tonnes, the Special Drawing Rights holdings and hard currency reserves of local banks and the BNR. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
